bbox_proposal_rank_policy.start_margin: signed rectangle separation from the starting frame; positive means the entire predicted rectangle is outside
bbox_proposal_rank_policy.one_step_area: maximum clipped projected rectangle area among supplied existing one-action cameras; not mask/evidence pixels or action availability
bbox_proposal_rank_policy.ordering: known start and one-step prediction first, predicted whole-box outside first, larger one-step rectangle area, larger signed starting margin, original input order
bbox_proposal_rank_policy.domain: retain every original entry and native token, including unknown or low-ranked predictions; no eligibility filter or cap
bbox_proposal_rank_policy.deadline: optional original soft-deadline callback before each point; exceptions propagate before any returned ranked pool, without mutating the input
bbox_proposal_rank_policy.unchanged: all actual physical, target, mask, RGB, evidence and witness checks; side/seed assignment, counters and schedules
bbox_proposal_rank_policy.scope: proposal prediction only; no acceptance result or measured visibility is produced

flip_geometry_policy.input_domain: all original native query tokens before horizontal, screen-side, or native-surface-point distance-ratio pruning
flip_geometry_policy.candidate_roles: A/B are unchanged stable candidate names and metadata.position distance roles; either role may lie on either screen side
flip_geometry_policy.anchor_center: native selected_position + original anchor axisAlignedBoundingBox.size.y/2 in Y; explicit geometric prediction, not physical or settled measurement
flip_geometry_policy.distance: full3D Euclidean distance from predicted anchor centre to candidate metadata.position; near<far and far>=1.5*near
flip_geometry_policy.prefix: all8 projected original anchor AABB corners known in front of camera; whole predicted rectangle outside v0 by at least10 pixels
flip_geometry_policy.one_step: each world independently has a supplied existing one-action camera with a known bbox and strictly positive clipped rectangle area; actions may differ
flip_geometry_policy.agent_range: original Look proposal constraint: native selected surface point within3m of original agent position
flip_geometry_policy.unknown: unknown projection/geometry never counts as a passing prediction
flip_geometry_policy.combination: two certified opposite-role points at distinct native positions; factorized checks followed by lazy Cartesian enumeration and full-tuple validation
flip_geometry_policy.fallback: selected first then same certified role domain, maximum40; revalidate every actual native point against the fixed opposite point before placement
flip_geometry_policy.seed: original seed0 canonical A/B assignment remains; actual w0/w1 source_sides may be A/B or B/A
flip_geometry_policy.stay: original historical Stay domain, ordering, schedule, retry rules and scientific validation untouched
flip_geometry_policy.storage: all prefilter input occurrences/reasons retained as compact native query references; complete coordinates stay in original native-query evidence
flip_geometry_policy.scope: proposal geometry only; no measured mask pixels, physical validity or scientific acceptance claim

clone_raw_storage_limit.scope: disabled cloning; scene-wide raw storage cap retained as infrastructure only
clone_raw_storage_limit.purpose: hard storage guard, not a scientific acceptance threshold
clone_raw_storage_limit.on_limit: stop raw materialization and continue search; no evidence-incomplete pair admission

preflight_policy.object_scope: all objects reported in metadata, matched by stable name
preflight_policy.initial_displacement: Euclidean initial-to-current displacement; path length is diagnostic only

evidence_policy.look_region: union of the edited anchor X masks in the two first-observation frames

raw_evidence_policy.common_preflight_clone_baseline: complete raw including reusable native placement queries saved immediately
raw_evidence_policy.attempt_raw: memory until verdict; qualified pair or first three occurrences of any complete rejection reason
raw_evidence_policy.other_rejection: compact JSON key measurements plus one <=128x128 JPEG
raw_evidence_policy.black_frame: bounded measured terminal proof; full attempt may remain incomplete
raw_evidence_policy.process_loss: unreturned child memory marked incomplete; never fabricated or counted as complete
raw_evidence_policy.source_image_transfer: private child config bytes only; excluded from result config and FINAL metrics
raw_evidence_policy.on_cap: continue search; compact records remain; incomplete evidence never accepted

search_raw_budget.scope: one scene session including all construction Controllers and returned replay payloads
search_raw_budget.on_cap: stop raw writes; continue measured search; incomplete evidence cannot be accepted

solvability_policy.per_world_condition: at least one actual existing observation action sees anchor X
solvability_policy.action_domain: per-world unchanged observation_actions on the same fixed reachable list; deterministic union
solvability_policy.selected_common_evidence: unchanged raw and marked X-mask union channel difference >10 on >=250 pixels
solvability_policy.unavailable: authenticated native path failure; not an observation and never X=0
solvability_policy.missing_evidence: unknown, never treated as zero or accepted

generation_policy.flip_assignment: SHA256 canonical JSON {attempt_index,scene,seed}; first byte low bit; 0=A,1=B in w0
generation_policy.stay_schedule: alternate A/B after view expansion within each candidate-anchor combination
generation_policy.empty_or_exhausted_side: emit only actual remaining proposals and explicitly record fallback
generation_policy.mode_schedule: interleave view-expanded Flip and Stay; continue remaining mode on exhaustion
generation_policy.eligibility: original placement tokens, same-position rejection, and original views unchanged
generation_policy.interpretation: proposal roles only; no claim of balanced accepted data or physical validity

config.validation_scope: T01v2 construction and supplement4(a) one-step observability; T02 P-table/BFS checks pending

candidate_policy_spec.candidate_domain: exactly the two stable-name marked pickupables A/B; other objects are not selectable targets
candidate_policy_spec.v0: each actual mask >=250 at255 and 3D metadata centre distance from agent <=1.5m
candidate_policy_spec.ordering: for each actual v0: same-category pairs first, then different-category pairs; stable names within pairs
candidate_policy_spec.anchor: one object of its category in full inventory; category differs from both candidates; unchanged nonrolling moved-object filter
candidate_policy_spec.instruction: Select the marked object closest to the <anchor_type>.
candidate_policy_spec.marks: only A/B receive marks; unchanged actual mask/mark rendering
candidate_policy_spec.scope: construction-stage qualification; T02 table/BFS/cache checks remain separate

nonrolling_anchor_exclusions.category_matching: exact case-sensitive metadata.objectType; suffixes apply to every category

projection_pool_policy.camera: actual metadata cameraPosition, agent yaw and cameraHorizon, vertical fov, screenWidth/screenHeight
projection_pool_policy.projection: Unity +Z forward/+X right/+Y up; positive horizon looks down; image edge coordinates [0,width) x [0,height)
projection_pool_policy.proposal_point: native selected_position plus anchor AABB half-height in Y; placement input remains native point
projection_pool_policy.direct: projected point in the starting frame; original horizontal near-to-far order; at most 40 per side
projection_pool_policy.look: positive camera depth, >=10px beyond at least one starting-frame edge; in frame after an existing observation action; native point <=3m from agent; at most 12 per side
projection_pool_policy.schedule: Look/Direct alternate globally; each pool independently retains Flip/Stay and expanded Stay A/B alternation; truthful exhaustion fallback
projection_pool_policy.orientation: unchanged seed0 SHA256(scene, actual global attempt index); applied by caller after scheduling
projection_pool_policy.retry: selected unchanged native token first, then remaining same-side pool tokens in recorded order; at most 40 total
projection_pool_policy.scope: proposal prefilter only; does not establish visibility, action feasibility, physics, evidence or acceptance

attempt_setup_policy.timing: restore common baseline before each frozen build_pair positions the agent at v0
attempt_setup_policy.baseline: same validated settled or clone common baseline supplied to every attempt
attempt_setup_policy.verification: unchanged restoration_state: all movable/pickupable positions <=1cm and encoded full agent pose exact
attempt_setup_policy.signed_zero: unchanged encoded comparison; signed-zero differences remain mismatches
attempt_setup_policy.paired_prefix: no additional restore/reset/agent action between w0 and w1
attempt_setup_policy.setup_failure: record rejected attempt; no w0 physical measurement invented
attempt_setup_policy.terminal_failure: black frame, deadline and process interrupt propagate through existing cleanup
attempt_setup_policy.retention: existing accepted/first-three-reason/terminal evidence policy and byte caps unchanged

config.initial_agent_setup: actual canonical TeleportFull before settled preflight; retain command and actual response
config.controller_restart: only when native failed placement changes reported pose/identity; previous Controller must be confirmed stopped

frozen_render_policy.physics: unchanged two native placements and settling checks; retain both original physical snapshots
frozen_render_policy.requested_render_worlds: complete physical w0 pose list for both worlds; replace only X position and rotation with physically settled w1 X
frozen_render_policy.render_actions: PausePhysicsAutoSim; SetObjectPoses(placeStationary=True), PhysicsSyncTransforms, Pass for w0 then w1; no agent action or physics advance between captures
frozen_render_policy.readback: all requested editable poses checked against actual metadata; exact equality and maximum position/rotation differences recorded
frozen_render_policy.acceptance: unchanged restoration position<=1cm/exact agent and physical/image/witness criteria; no new exact-pose acceptance threshold
frozen_render_policy.actual_cross_world: all nonanchor native position/rotation differences recorded without replacing measurements by zero

construction_metadata_retention_policy.encoding: original save_json bytes and SHA; exclusive creation; no reconstruction or reference substitution
construction_metadata_retention_policy.accounting: one separate bounded metadata reserve per scene, with per-file limit; excluded from raw payload bytes
construction_metadata_retention_policy.raw_cap: unchanged raw budget, black reserve and evidence_complete_for_acceptance; no resident/pending payload flush
construction_metadata_retention_policy.index: original index generation and memory-only scope retained; every referenced scientific file still requires original independent authentication
construction_metadata_retention_policy.on_metadata_limit: explicit scene failure; never silently leave a claimed metadata reference only in memory
construction_metadata_retention_policy.phase: construction common/closing phase only; replay stores and active attempt evidence unchanged

stay_w1_order_policy.enumeration: same unordered Stay combinations; for each fixed w0, order its remaining w1 suffix far-to-near
stay_w1_order_policy.distance: 3D Euclidean native position; descending; deterministic ascending native-key ties
stay_w1_order_policy.native_origin: actual physically settled w0 anchor metadata.position, including successful native fallback
stay_w1_order_policy.native_order: scheduled w1 first when w0 did not fall back and that point is untried; remaining retries far-to-near from actual w0
stay_w1_order_policy.fallback_order: when w0 fell back or scheduled w1 was already tried, remaining eligible same-side points far-to-near
stay_w1_order_policy.exploration: per Controller/common baseline/view/identity/pool/side/successful w0 point, skip only ledger-recorded w1 attempts
stay_w1_order_policy.unchanged: native tokens, pool membership/caps, Flip sequence, Stay A/B alternation, Look/Direct alternation, seed0, all acceptance thresholds

config.attempt_limit_scope: infrastructure guard; collection caps and explicit scene deadline are authoritative

policy.deadline: worker soft deadline is parent hard deadline minus grace; no added allocation time
policy.authoritative: generator returned after cleanup; matching full metrics and complete sealed journal
policy.post_cleanup: parent verifies identical seal after owned process cleanup
policy.missing_receipt: nonzero; last progress explicitly nonfinal; no final counters or journal hash
